about: The Abyssal Sire (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_Sire) in the Abyssal Nexus, as captured (rsprox captures 572, 1762 and 2188, Leagues V, rev 227-228; 2121-2136 for the Nexus) with the Wiki's numbers after Poll 84 (30 April 2025), which came after the captures. Tiles are absolute on the cache map. See docs/abyssal-sire.md.

locs.about: The map has every vent as the dead one (26954); live OSRS puts the wheezing vent (26953) on each living lung's tile, the invisible blocker (26209) as it dies and the dead vent back 7 ticks later.

offsets.about: From the Sire's sleeping tile (south-west corner), the same in every lair (captured): where it stands in phase 2 and in phase 3, and the tile the explosion pulls the player to.

messages.noTask: The Sire takes no interest in you.
messages.stunned: The Sire has been disorientated temporarily.
messages.alreadyStunned: The Sire is disoriented. Maybe you can do something useful while it's unable to control the tentacles.
messages.tentaclesInTheWay: You can't deal much damage with those tentacles getting in the way.
messages.killCount: Your Abyssal Sire kill count is: <col=ff0000>{kills}</col>.

phase1.about: Waking: tentacles 2 ticks after the Sire (captured). A stun is 46 ticks (captured; Wiki 27 seconds); the tentacles calm 3-4 ticks into it. 75 ranged or magic damage, or a shadow spell by its tier (Wiki), stuns; on a sleeping Sire the spell's stun waits out its 10-tick waking (Wiki). The awake Sire throws spawns or a pool every 7 ticks (attack speed, Wiki).

toPhase2.about: After the last lung: the Sire turns to its puppet form with sire_mobilising, sets off 7 ticks later at the player's running pace (Wiki, Poll 84; captured at 1 tile a tick before it) and stands up 1 tick after arriving.

phase2.about: Melee within 2 tiles of its body (Wiki), every 7 ticks, in the captured mix. Prayed maxima are the Wiki's (6, 6, 26); unprayed are the Wiki's 66 for the double whip and the same ratio for the other two (no source gives them). Further than 2 tiles: spawns or a pool; attacked from there: the player is pulled in (busy for 3 ticks) and hit by the double hook. Below half its hitpoints it walks to the middle.

toPhase3.about: It walks to its phase 3 tile, plays sire_panic_mode 1 tick after arriving and panics 7 ticks after that, with four spawns (Wiki) and its tentacles awake.

phase3.about: Panicking: a pool every 6-11 ticks (captured), no melee. Below 35% (Wiki): sire_apocalypse, the player pulled to the explosion tile 3 ticks later, the explosion 3 ticks after that: up to 96 within 4 tiles of its body (captured: hit at 1-4, never at 5 or more). Then a flood of spawns and pools until 15 minions are out and 3 pools are done (Wiki).

miasma.about: Captured: the pool hurts on its 3rd, 4th and 5th ticks, less each time, on its tile and the 8 around it. Its first hit can poison, 8 damage (Wiki).

tentacles.about: Active tentacles strike a player within a tile of their footprint every 4 ticks (Wiki), the hit a tick later (captured); typeless, up to 30 (Wiki), Protect from Melee taking a little off (assumed a fifth).

minions.about: A spawn lands 6 ticks after it is thrown (projectile end 180 cycles). Spawns and scions pick melee next to the player, ranged otherwise (Wiki), every 4 ticks. A spawn matures after 20 ticks (Wiki: 12 seconds) and a minion that can't attack for 50 ticks dies (Wiki: about 30 seconds). Max hits are the Wiki's.

kill.about: Captured: the kill count and the Sire's removal 2 ticks after its death animation starts, its lungs, tentacles and the sleeping Sire back a tick later. Slayer experience is the Wiki's 478.

font.about: Captured: the object box, the font's splash and sound at 2, the reward at 4. Rolls (Wiki: Unsired): out of 128 without the pet (5 of them the pet), out of 123 with it; no bludgeon piece twice until all three are had.
font.placeText: You place the Unsired into the Font of Consumption...
font.rewardText:
The Font consumes the Unsired and returns you a
reward.

overseer.about: Varbit 3261 (abyssalsire_lore) picks the Overseer's loc (0-3) or his residue and book (4-7); varbit 3262 (abyssalsire_parts_stored) holds the parts he has: spine 1, claw 2, axon 4. Lines: Wiki, Transcript:The Overseer.

eyes.about: Captured with nobody inside; the other lines are the Wiki's.
eyes.empty: There are no adventurers in this chamber.
eyes.occupied: There is an adventurer in this chamber.
eyes.emptyForAWhile: The area feels like it's been empty for a while now.

nexus.about: The one-way passage in the Abyss's outer ring (Wiki: Abyssal Nexus) and the appendage that teleports to Lumbridge (Wiki: Appendage).
